permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect to your Mac to send messages, voice recordings, selected photos and optional location, and receive Dot replies. Also used for pairing and connection management.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record messages with G2 microphones (up to 30 seconds). Optional voice activation keeps the microphone on to detect the cue on your phone; only speech after the cue is sent to your Mac for transcription.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Share phone location with Dot through your Mac only when enabled. Optional history stays on your Mac for up to 7 days and can be deleted. Optional walking/terrain requests send route coordinates to FOSSGIS and terrain areas to AWS.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Take a photo when you tap Camera. It is sent to Dot only when you send the draft, including automatic sending after voice input.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Select a photo with your phone photo picker. It is sent to Dot only when you send the draft, including automatic sending after voice input.
